item.title: Python - replace long if/elif chain with dict mappings
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Python - Avoiding long if/elif chain with dictionary mappings

########################
# Long if/elif chain

def keydown(key):
global paddle1_vel, paddle2_vel
if key == simplegui.KEY_MAP[“up”]:
paddle2_vel -= 2
elif key == simplegui.KEY_MAP[“down”]:
paddle2_vel += 2
elif key == simplegui.KEY_MAP[“w”]:
paddle1_vel -= 2
elif key == simplegui.KEY_MAP[“s”]:
paddle1_vel += 2

########################
# Avoiding long if/elif chain with dictionary mapping values to actions

def paddle1_faster():
global paddle1_vel
paddle1_vel += 2

def paddle1_slower():
global paddle1_vel
paddle1_vel -= 2
